subject.title: Memory MVP: add ingestion helpers and CLI/skill surface

question: Should OpenClaw standardize a first-class memory operator facade in the default memory slot now, route this to plugin/ClawHub packages, or wait until the schema/provenance/write/review companion issues converge?
rationale: The requested work is a new user-facing CLI/skill/API surface that crosses memory lifecycle semantics and current plugin boundaries, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Keep as Memory MVP design work
options.body: Leave this open until the schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and review/edit/forget issues converge, then implement a small default memory facade.

options.title: Route to plugin or ClawHub
options.body: Close core work if maintainers decide Engram, Memory Wiki, LanceDB, or another plugin package is the right boundary and no SDK gap remains.

options.title: Implement immediately in memory-core
options.body: Add the commands and tools now, accepting the risk of duplicating plugin surfaces or freezing lifecycle semantics early.

recommendation.title: Keep as Memory MVP design work
recommendation.body: Leave this open until the schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and review/edit/forget issues converge, then implement a small default memory facade.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the clearest history-backed owner for the memory-core source path and repository-level product boundary in this checkout.
